title: cert.rs: trust anchor validity check deserves a comment citing RFC 5280 §6.1.3(a)(1)
description: In validate_chain(), after matching a trust anchor by name, the code calls check_validity(anchor, now) before trusting the anchor's signature. This is correct per RFC 5280 §6.1.3(a)(1) but many implementations skip this check. Without a comment citing the RFC, a future contributor may incorrectly remove it as redundant (thinking trust anchors are always valid by policy). The comment 'Verify the trust anchor's own validity period before trusting it' is present but does not cite the RFC, which would make the defensive intent explicit.
